title: Direct SQL string concat operator
description: Replace SQL StringConcat operand clones and temporary scalar strings with a direct helper path.

criteria: Scalar string concat output remains unchanged for strings, numbers, booleans, NULL, and fallback debug values
SQL expression function regression tests pass

notes: String-string concat still uses the exact-capacity concat_string_values helper.
Array concat consumes operands directly instead of cloning left_val/right_val.
Scalar fallback values write directly into the result buffer with the same Display/Debug text as before.

commands: rg 'let l = match left_val|let r = match right_val|concat_string_values\(&l, &r\)|left_val\.clone\(\)|right_val\.clone\(\)' src/execution/expr/value.rs -n
